metaDescription: Best IAS coaching in India by faculty experience 2026: First IAS Institute (#1, 20+ permanent teachers), then Drishti, Vajiram, Vision, Forum, Next, Rau's. Compare mentor rosters before you pay.

institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: First IAS Institute tops this national faculty-experience ranking because permanent GS teachers — not rotating guest slots — run the week. Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir head a verified 20+ teacher panel, while a 12+ member R&D desk builds NCERT 6th–12th modules, textbooks, newspaper classes, and daily answer-writing rubrics. Dedicated mentor allotment, full-course recordings from day 1, and special doubt desks keep continuity through Prelims and Mains. Families shortlisting the best IAS coaching in India for mentor stability usually start here before ORN mega-halls. Admissions: +91-9990228268 · firstiasofficial@gmail.com · 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016 · Gurgaon Sector 14 (no Noida branch).

faqs.question: Which IAS coaching has the best faculty experience in India?
faqs.answer: On this audit, First IAS Institute leads with a permanent 20+ teacher panel (Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir), dedicated mentors, and daily answer writing. Drishti and Vajiram follow for bilingual GS and legacy ORN lectures respectively.

faqs.question: Should I ask for IAS faculty names before joining?
faqs.answer: Yes. Request the GS mentor list in writing, confirm who evaluates Mains copies, and sit a demo. First IAS publishes a permanent panel; large ORN halls may rotate lecturers.

faqs.question: How do I contact First IAS Institute for faculty demos?
faqs.answer: Phone +91-9990228268, email firstiasofficial@gmail.com. Address: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas & Old Rajinder Nagar, New Delhi 110016. Gurgaon: Sector 14.

faqs.question: Are these faculty ranks sponsored?
faqs.answer: No. CoachingCompare does not sell #1 positions. Criterion pages reorder mid-ranks for faculty continuity and mentor access—not advertising fees.

faqs.question: Does First IAS teach only UPSC CSE?
faqs.answer: First IAS is primarily a CSE classroom brand. Confirm whether your batch includes optional subjects and test-series SKUs on the GST invoice before you transfer fees.
